prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE original fixed orbital POWER module body for OpenTTD, no coupling component.
Image1 is plain shallow FLOOR/CAMERA GUIDE ONLY. Render a very thin flat2x2 steel diamond deck following the guide: about1000px wide and460px high, corners(640,330),(1140,560),(640,790),(140,560) on1280x1024 transparent canvas. All four floor corners visible, shallow near2:1floor, no thick foundation or perspective convergence.
EXACT hardware: TWO LOW rectangular navy-blue photovoltaic banks on short cream/graphite supports in the rear half, one left and one right, with blue solar-cell grids and silver trim. They are low compact flat panels, not towers or cabinets. ONE SMALL squat cream/navy electrical control box near the middle just in front of the PV banks, with one small simple horizontal BLUE GLASS status window on its visible front face. The two banks belong to a single module and one producer. Keep a broad flat open front apron, thin cream/silver perimeter and four grey deck tile seams. Restrained crisp retro industrial game-sprite materials; upper-left light.
Do not add a third panel bank, Core command hub, warehouse cabinet, fuel tank, cargo, crates, crane, service machine, craft, robot or any other equipment. No clamp/coupling: a passive construction coupling will be a separately registered genuine component later. No output numbers, labels, arrows, symbols, text, axes, ground or external shadow. True transparent background. Every whole subject pixel at least100px clear of all image edges; complete floor corners and all panels inside frame. ONE complete isolated fixed view, no sheet. Image1's shallow floor geometry takes priority over a steeper generic camera.
